name: Rhode Island
agency: Rhode Island Department of Business Regulation (DBR), Division of Commercial Licensing - Liquor Enforcement and Compliance

licence_data.on_premise_codes: Retail licences are municipal: Class B = restaurant/bar (substantial food business), Class C = tavern/bar, Class D = club, Class E/F etc. DBR issues only manufacturer/wholesale/some retail classes.
licence_data.terms_notes: No statewide public dataset seen. Municipalities must report all active licences to DBR each Dec 1 (Excel form); DBR contact for Excel: leeann.desilets@dbr.ri.gov. Obtain compiled list via APRA public records request.

local_control: Retail on-premise licences (Class B/C/D etc.) are issued by the 39 city/town councils or boards of licenses (e.g. Providence Board of Licenses), not the state.
alternatives: Providence open data 'Active Business Licenses in Providence' (data.providenceri.gov, dataset ui7z-kv69) may include liquor licences
RIDOH food establishment inspection/licence data
APRA request to DBR for the compiled municipal Dec-1 annual liquor licence reports
Individual town clerk licence lists
manual_steps: Submit APRA public records request to RI DBR (Division of Commercial Licensing, liquor) for the latest compiled municipal annual liquor licence reports (all active Class B/C/D etc.) in Excel
Optionally pull Providence ui7z-kv69 via Socrata API for Providence refreshes
Repeat annually after Dec 1 reporting deadline
notes: Small state (39 municipalities) so a one-time request + annual refresh is workable. Municipal reports vary in completeness. Providence dataset id seen in search result URL but its liquor coverage not verified.

name: South Carolina
agency: South Carolina Department of Revenue (SCDOR), Alcohol Beverage Licensing (ABL)

licence_data.on_premise_codes: On-premise: On-Premises Beer & Wine Permit (PBW), 7-Day On-Premises Beer & Wine (PO7), and Liquor-by-the-Drink/minibottle licences (LBD); off-premise: BW off-premise, retail liquor store.
licence_data.terms_notes: SCDOR 'License Searches & ABL Resources' page offers lookups of ABL licensed locations and active licences; no bulk file or dataset id confirmed in search results.

local_control: State-issued by SCDOR; local governments can protest; Sunday sales (7-day permits) depend on county/municipal referendum.
alternatives: Public records (FOIA) request to SCDOR ABL (ABL@dor.sc.gov, 803-898-5864) for all active on-premise licences
SC DHEC/DES retail food establishment inspection data
County/city business licence open data (e.g. Charleston, Greenville)
manual_steps: Check the SCDOR 'License Searches & ABL Resources' page for any active-licence export; if only lookup, submit SC FOIA request to SCDOR ABL for a spreadsheet of active PBW, PO7 and LBD licences with addresses
Repeat request periodically (quarterly)
notes: Could not confirm a downloadable active-licence list via search; the ABL resources page may contain one - verify manually. LBD licences are separate from beer/wine permits, so a full bar holds several.

name: South Dakota
agency: South Dakota Department of Revenue, Special Taxes Division (alcohol licensing)

licence_data.on_premise_codes: On-sale liquor (full, quota 1 per 2,000 residents), on-sale wine/cider (retail wine), on-sale malt beverage; off-sale package licences separate.
licence_data.terms_notes: No statewide public licensee list found; DOR contact SpecialT@state.sd.us / 605-773-3311.

local_control: Licences require local approval: municipal governing body (finance officer) inside city limits, county commission (auditor) outside; the state DOR then issues.
alternatives: Request statewide active on-sale licence list from SD DOR Special Taxes (SpecialT@state.sd.us)
City licence-holder lists (e.g. Rapid City finance 'License Holders' PDFs, Sioux Falls, Watertown, Yankton)
SD Department of Health food service inspection data
manual_steps: Email SD DOR Special Taxes Division (SpecialT@state.sd.us) requesting a spreadsheet of all active on-sale (liquor, wine, malt beverage) licences with premises addresses
If refused, collect city lists from Sioux Falls and Rapid City (largest markets) finance offices
Refresh annually (licences renew July 1)
notes: Low population; Sioux Falls and Rapid City cover most bars/restaurants. Tribal lands have separate tribal alcohol regulation.

sources.title: Liquor Retailers & Other Liquor Licenses | SD DOR

name: Tennessee

licence_data.on_premise_codes: TABC Liquor-by-the-Drink (LBD / on-premises consumption) licences: restaurant, hotel, private club, etc. Ordinary beer (<=8% ABW) permits are issued by local beer boards, not TABC.
licence_data.terms_notes: Public records requests to TABC.PublicRecords@tn.gov (open records request form).

local_control: Hybrid: TABC issues LBD (spirits/wine/high-gravity) licences statewide; beer permits are issued by county/city beer boards (e.g. Metro Nashville Beer Permit Board).
alternatives: Public records request to TABC for all active LBD licences (TABC.PublicRecords@tn.gov)
Nashville open data 'Beer Permit Locations' (data.nashville.gov, dataset 3wb6-xy3j, ArcGIS/Socrata, geocoded)
Memphis/Knoxville/Chattanooga beer board lists
TN Dept of Health food service inspection data
manual_steps: Submit TABC open records request form to TABC.PublicRecords@tn.gov asking for all active LBD / on-premises consumption licences with addresses and licence type (spreadsheet)
Automate Nashville beer permits via data.nashville.gov 3wb6-xy3j
Repeat TABC request quarterly
notes: Beer-only bars/restaurants will be missing from a TABC LBD list; need local beer board data. Some counties/cities remain dry for LBD.

sources.title: License Search - Tennessee Alcoholic Beverage Commission
Beer Permit Locations | Nashville Open Data

name: Texas

licence_data.on_premise_codes: License Type column: MB = Mixed Beverage (bar/restaurant spirits on-premise), BG = Wine & Malt Beverage Retailer (on-premise beer/wine), N = Private Club Registration, NB = Private Club Beer & Wine; BQ/Q etc. are off-premise. Also subordinate flags (FB food & beverage cert, LH late hours, etc.).
licence_data.terms_notes: Also TABC License Information dataset 7hf9-qc9f (https://data.texas.gov/dataset/TABC-License-Information/7hf9-qc9f, CSV rows.csv download) with address/county/phone columns. kguh-7q9z covers AIMS (since Sep 2021) + legacy, active and inactive - filter on status. Lat/long not confirmed in results (treat as not geocoded).

local_control: State-issued by TABC; local option elections determine wet/dry status by county/JP precinct/city.
alternatives: TABC License Information dataset 7hf9-qc9f
Mixed Beverage Gross Receipts tax data (Comptroller) for sales volume by location
notes: ~123k rows including inactive; filter to active MB/BG/N/NB. Dry areas remain in parts of TX. Mixed beverage gross receipts dataset is a useful ranking signal.

sources.title: TABC License Information - Texas Open Data Portal

name: Utah
agency: Utah Department of Alcoholic Beverage Services (DABS)

licence_data.on_premise_codes: Licence categories in list: Bar Establishment, Restaurant Full Service, Restaurant Limited Service, Restaurant Beer Only, Club, Tavern, Reception Center, etc.
licence_data.terms_notes: PDF 'Licenses by County, DBA' found on legacy abc.utah.gov domain (pre-2021 DABC name) - may be stale/moved; current abs.utah.gov License Information page reportedly links a licensee list. Must parse PDF.

local_control: State-issued by DABS with local consent from city/county required.
alternatives: Current licensee list on https://abs.utah.gov/licenses-permits/license-information/
GRAMA records request to DABS for Excel export from its licensing system
DABS commission meeting minutes (new licences monthly)
manual_steps: Open abs.utah.gov License Information page and download the current licensee list (PDF); verify legacy webapps2 URL still works
Parse PDF into rows; or file GRAMA request to DABS for an Excel version
Repeat monthly
notes: Control state: DABS runs spirits retail; on-premise licences capped by population quotas. Legacy PDF URL may be outdated.

name: Vermont
agency: Vermont Department of Liquor and Lottery, Division of Liquor Control (DLL)

licence_data.on_premise_codes: First Class = on-premise beer & wine (restaurant/bar); Third Class = on-premise spirits (held with First Class); Second Class = off-premise stores.
licence_data.terms_notes: 'Licensing Lists and Reports' page (also on DLL portal https://dllportal.my.vermont.gov/DLLLicenseManagment/s/licensing-lists-and-reports) provides reports on license holders; exact format not confirmed.

local_control: First/Second Class applications are approved by the town/city local control board (selectboard/council) before state issuance.
alternatives: Public records request to DLL for active First/Third Class licensees
VT Dept of Health food/lodging licence data
manual_steps: Download the active licensees report from liquorcontrol.vermont.gov/information/lists-reports (or DLL portal) and filter First/Third Class
Repeat monthly; if the report is not machine-readable, request an Excel export from DLL
notes: Control state for spirits (agency stores). Report format/URL of the file itself not verified.

sources.title: Licensing Lists and Reports | Vermont Division of Liquor Control
Licensing Lists and Reports - DLL Portal

name: Virginia
agency: Virginia Alcoholic Beverage Control Authority (Virginia ABC)

licence_data.on_premise_codes: Licence types include Mixed Beverage Restaurant, Mixed Beverage Caterer, On-Premises Wine and Beer, On-and-Off Premises Wine and Beer, Retail On-Premises Beer; filter on those.
licence_data.terms_notes: Linked from 'Find a License' page as 'downloadable file of Virginia ABC Licensees (XLS)'. Columns not confirmed.

local_control: State-issued by Virginia ABC; localities may object; some localities restrict mixed beverage.
alternatives: Norfolk open data ABC Licenses (data.norfolk.gov y6t7-ma9g)
Virginia ABC public Licensee Search Tool
notes: ~20,000 licensed businesses total (all classes). Scheduled download of the xlsx is straightforward; verify update cadence.

name: Washington
agency: Washington State Liquor and Cannabis Board (LCB/WSLCB)

licence_data.on_premise_codes: Frequently Requested Lists include 'On Premise Licensees' (tavern, bar, nightclub, restaurants - spirits/beer/wine restaurant, beer/wine restaurant, tavern, nightclub) separate from off-premise list.
licence_data.terms_notes: Files download as .ASP; save as Excel. Per RCW 42.56.070(8), lists of individuals from public records may not be used for commercial purposes - check applicability (business lists).

local_control: State-issued by LCB; local authorities notified and may object.
alternatives: data.wa.gov 'LCB Liquor Renewal' dataset 9dee-kzm5 (Socrata; renewal applications with details sent to local authorities)
data.lcb.wa.gov portal (violations etc.)
WA DOR business lookup (LCB endorsements)
manual_steps: Download 'On Premise Licensees' list from lcb.wa.gov/records/frequently-requested-lists (save .ASP as Excel) monthly; can likely be scripted once the direct file URL is confirmed
Review RCW 42.56.070(8) commercial-use restriction before use
notes: Near-full automation possible via scripted download; Socrata 9dee-kzm5 gives renewals only (not full active list). Tribal casinos may be under separate compacts.

name: West Virginia
agency: West Virginia Alcohol Beverage Control Administration (WVABCA)

licence_data.on_premise_codes: Class A = on-premise; Class B = off-premise. Types: Private Club Restaurant, Private Club Bar, Class A on-premise beer/wine (restaurant), Retail Wine Restaurant, Retail Fraternal, etc. Search can filter 'All Retail' and by county.
licence_data.terms_notes: Search updated daily; no bulk export seen.

local_control: State-issued by WVABCA; local option for Sunday sales.
alternatives: WV FOIA request to WVABCA Licensing (ABCA.Licensing@wv.gov, 304-356-5500) for all active Class A licences
Scrape wvabca.com license search by county and licence type
County health department food permits
manual_steps: Submit WV FOIA request to WVABCA Licensing (ABCA.Licensing@wv.gov) for spreadsheet of all active retail on-premise (Class A / private club / restaurant) licences with addresses
Alternatively script the licensesearch.aspx form per county and licence type (55 counties)
notes: Spirits wholesale is state-controlled (retail privatized). Private club licensing historically required membership.

sources.title: How do I Check to See if a License is Active? | WVABCA

name: Wisconsin
agency: Wisconsin Department of Revenue, Division of Alcohol Beverages (DAB)

licence_data.on_premise_codes: Class 'B' beer and 'Reserve Class B'/'Class B' liquor = bars/taverns/restaurants (on-premise); Class 'C' wine = restaurant wine only; Class 'A' = off-premise.
licence_data.terms_notes: DOR publishes all active retail licences reported by municipalities (Form AT-827, due July 15, updates any time) per Act 73. Bulk CSV not confirmed; 2025 Municipal Retail License Report posted online.

local_control: Retail licences issued by ~1,851 municipalities (cities, villages, towns); DOR compiles reports.
alternatives: DOR 2025 Municipal Retail License Report (posted online; see revenue.wi.gov news 2025-06-13)
Public records request to DOR for AT-827 compiled data in CSV
Milwaukee/Madison open data licence datasets
manual_steps: Check the DOR Retail Alcohol Beverage License Search / Municipal Retail License Report page for a downloadable statewide file; download annually after July 15
If only searchable, request the compiled AT-827 dataset (CSV) from DOR via public records request
notes: Wisconsin has very high bar density; many rural town-issued licences. Data quality depends on municipal reporting.

name: Wyoming
agency: Wyoming Department of Revenue, Liquor Division (WLD)

licence_data.on_premise_codes: Licence class column: Retail Liquor, Restaurant Liquor, Bar & Grill, Resort, Microbrewery etc. Retail liquor licences can operate as bars and package stores.
licence_data.terms_notes: 'Wyoming Active Liquor License Holder List' (class, name, products, business, address, phone) compiled by Liquor Division exists; only copy seen was on a third-party host, official URL on liquor365.wyo.gov not confirmed.

local_control: Licences issued by local licensing authorities: city/town councils inside municipalities, boards of county commissioners outside; Liquor Division reviews.
alternatives: County clerk / city clerk licence lists (Cheyenne, Casper, Laramie)
Request list from Liquor Division (307-777-6449)
manual_steps: Locate and download 'Wyoming Active Liquor License Holder List' from liquor365.wyo.gov (or request from Liquor Division)
Filter to Retail, Restaurant, Bar & Grill, Resort classes; refresh quarterly
notes: Control state (state wholesaler). ~1,794 licences total incl. 818 retail, 245 restaurant, 128 bar & grill. Wind River Reservation has tribal regulation.
